                                   BIOGRAPHICAL DATA                              
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    Mr. Zildjian T. Bermas was born in Iloilo to Mary Grace Bermas and Ramon
                                                                                  
               Bermas, and is a dedicated 22-year-old student currently pursuing a Bachelor of
                                                                                  
               Science in Computer Science at Cavite State University (CvSU) - Bacoor Campus.
                                                                                  
                    He received his elementary education in Vergonville Elementary School,
                                                                                  
               located in Las Pinas. Afterward, he left Las Pinas to continue his secondary education
                                                                                  
               in Bacoor, Cavite. His high school years were defined by a commitment to excellence,
                                                                                  
               a trait he learned from his family's example of persistence. He channeled this value
                                                                                  
               into both his studies and his extracurricular activities at the Academy for Christian
                                                                                  
               Education, a school that caters to students from elementary to senior high. This
                                                                                  
               dedication culminated in his being named Salutatorian of his graduating class, an
                                                                                  
               achievement that reflected his consistent hard work. Beyond academics, he embraced
                                                                                  
               leadership roles, serving as a cadet officer and president of the Supreme Pupil
                                                                                  
               Government. These experiences taught him invaluable lessons in discipline,
                                                                                  
               teamwork, and decision-making.                                     
                                                                                  
                    Now in his fourth year at Cavite State University - Bacoor Campus, he has built
                                                                                  
               a solid academic foundation in core computer science principles, including
                                                                                  
               programming, data structures, and software development. In addition to his formal
                                                                                  
               studies, Zildjian Bermas has cultivated a strong passion for the creative aspects of
                                                                                  
               technology, particularly in graphic design and web design. He has actively honed these
                                                                                  
               skills to complement his technical expertise, aiming to bridge the gap between
                                                                                  
               aesthetics and functionality.

                                          ABSTRACT                                
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               BERMAS, ZILDJIAN T., CORTES, MIKAELA ANNE V., GUINDAY, RAINA ISABEL
               M., MILLOSA, IVANA MARIEL B., SURECUT: A Mobile Application For    
               Commuters And Drivers With Real-Time Vehicle Tracking And Route    
               Visualization. Undergraduate Thesis. Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.
               Cavite State University - Bacoor City Campus, City of Bacoor, Cavite. June 2026.
               Adviser: Ms. Clarissa V. Rostrollo.                                
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    The study “SURECUT: A Mobile Application for Commuters and Drivers with
                                                                                  
               Real-Time Vehicle Tracking and Route Visualization” aimed to develop a sustainable
                                                                                  
               mobile transport application and route visualization system designed to enhance the
                                                                                  
               commuting experience and operational efficiency for the Pangkabuhayan Transport
                                                                                  
               Service Multipurpose Cooperative (PTSMC) and the commuting public in Bacoor City.
                                                                                  
               The system provides real-time vehicle tracking, live route visualization, seat availability
                                                                                  
               updates, and NFC-based cashless payments. It addresses critical local transportation
                                                                                  
               challenges such as prolonged passenger waiting times, heavy traffic congestion,
               difficulty in locating available vehicles, and the operational inefficiencies faced by
                                                                                  
               drivers who traditionally rely on chance ("swertihan") to find passengers.
                                                                                  
                    The study employed the Agile Design Thinking methodology to facilitate
                                                                                  
               iterative design, development, and refinement of the system through continuous user
                                                                                  
               feedback, emphasizing data gathered during the initial Empathize phase. The research
                                                                                  
               process involved identifying commuter and driver pain points through targeted surveys
                                                                                  
               and interviews, analyzing localized transit user needs, designing the mobile platform,
                                                                                  
               and evaluating its overall effectiveness. The system was engineered with distinct
                                                                                  
               access levels and integrated modules for commuters and drivers, including live location
                                                                                  
               tracking, an estimated arrival time (ETA) calculator, capacity indicators, and a secure
                                                                                  
               payment gateway.                                                   
                                                                                  
                    The findings revealed that the lack of real-time data heavily impacts both
                                                                                  
               commuter convenience and driver productivity, highlighting a need for centralized
                                                                                  
                                           viii                                   
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 9 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               digital transit solutions. The developed SURECUT application successfully resolved
                                                                                  
               these gaps by providing drivers with data-driven passenger indicators and offering
                                                                                  
               commuters live, reliable transit updates. Evaluation results showed that 140
                                                                                  
               respondents rated the SURECUT system as “Excellent,” achieving an overall General
                                                                                  
               Weighted Average (GWA) of 4.83 based on the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality
                                                                                  
               standards.                                                         
                                                                                  
                    The results indicate that a synchronized, technology-driven transport platform
                                                                                  
               can significantly optimize localized public utility vehicle operations. By aligning real-time
                                                                                  
               tracking with cashless transactions and capacity monitoring features, SURECUT offers
                                                                                  
               a highly scalable alternative to traditional, unmanaged transit systems. Based on these
                                                                                  
               results, it is recommended that PTSMC deploy the application. SURECUT effectively
                                                                                  
               bridges the operational gap between drivers and commuters utilizing their vehicles,
                                                                                  
               thereby fostering a more predictable, reliable, and convenient public transport
                                                                                  
               ecosystem.

                SURECUT: A MOBILE APPLICATION FOR COMMUTERS AND DRIVERS WITH      
                     REAL-TIME VEHICLE TRACKING AND ROUTE VISUALIZATION           
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                     Zildjian T. Bermas                           
                                   Mikaela Anne V. Cortes                         
                                   Raina Isabel M. Guinday                        
                                                                                  
                                   Ivana Mariel B. Millosa                        
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                An undergraduate thesis manuscript submitted to the faculty of the Department of
                Computer Studies, Cavite State University – Bacoor City Campus, City of Bacoor,
                Cavite, in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the degree of Bachelor of Science
                                                                                  
                in Computer Science with Contribution No. BSCS-2025-2026-001. Prepared under the
                supervision of Ms. Clarissa V. Rostrollo.                         
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                    INTRODUCTION                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    Public transportation plays a crucial role in urban mobility, yet inefficiencies
                                                                                  
               within the commute norm lead to significant daily struggles for both commuters and
                                                                                  
               drivers. In the Philippines, commuters' daily challenges primarily involve long waits
                                                                                  
               and severe traffic congestion caused by a shortage of vehicles, exacerbated by an
                                                                                  
               ineffective and disjointed public transportation network (Musa, 2023). Bacoor City,
               Cavite, faces the issues acutely due to its rapid urbanization and high volume of daily
                                                                                  
               travelers. Many commuters in the city experience uncertainty about travel schedules
                                                                                  
               and difficulty identifying available routes, resulting in lost time and frustration.
                                                                                  
                    To address the challenges, the researchers aimed to support the local
                                                                                  
               transport sector by focusing on the Pangkabuhayan Transport Service Multipurpose
                                                                                  
               Cooperative (PTSMC). As a cooperative managing modernized jeepney operations
                                                                                  
               in the area, the PTSMC is responsible for maintaining service reliability; however, the
                                                                                  
               cooperative currently faces a "visibility gap" in its operations. Interview reports with
                                                                                  
               local drivers reveal that the current 7-10 minute mandatory dispatch protocol often
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 23 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       2          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               forces vehicles to depart from terminals with low occupancy. Once on the road,
                                                                                  
               locating commuters outside of terminals is largely a matter of "swertihan" (luck), as
                                                                                  
               drivers lack the digital tools to identify areas of high commuter demand. The
                                                                                  
               operational guesswork leads to unnecessary fuel consumption and potential income
               loss for the cooperative and its members.                          
                                                                                  
                    To bridge the gap, the researchers developed Surecut, a real-time vehicle
                                                                                  
               tracking and route visualization application designed for both the PTSMC and the
                                                                                  
               commuting public. The application serves as a central hub for collecting and
                                                                                  
               disseminating crucial transit data, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions.
                                                                                  
               According to McCarty (2022), GPS is a foundational technology designed to assist in
                                                                                  
               navigation, allowing people to travel efficiently, especially in unfamiliar locations
                                                                                  
               where knowledge of local transportation options or terminal locations may be limited.
                                                                                  
               By integrating the technology, Surecut provides commuters with real-time updates on
                                                                                  
               vehicle locations, arrival estimates, and seat availability, empowering them to take
                                                                                  
               proactive measures during their daily travels.                     
                                                                                  
                    In addition, the application provides an advanced platform for coordination
                                                                                  
               between the transport operators and the commuters. For the drivers, the system
                                                                                  
               offers features to manually update seat occupancy through a color-coded system
                                                                                  
               (Red/Yellow/Green), preventing overloading and ensuring a safer boarding process.
                                                                                  
               For the PTSMC management, the application provides a dedicated interface to
                                                                                  
               monitor fleet activity and generate digital income reports. The centralized platform for
                                                                                  
               tracking the status of vehicle units helps improve the overall effectiveness of the local
               transportation network.                                            
                                                                                  
                    Generally, the study aimed to develop a sustainable mobile application that
                                                                                  
               synchronizes the operational needs of the PTSMC with the convenience of the
                                                                                  
               commuters in Bacoor City. The system functions as a digital management
                                                                                  
               infrastructure that provides the cooperative with real-time fleet oversight and
                                                                                  
               automated reporting features. By bridging the information gap through GPS
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 24 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       3          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               technology and manual capacity indicators, Surecut reduces commuter anxiety and
                                                                                  
               optimizes driver income per trip. Ultimately, the application transforms a disjointed
                                                                                  
               transit routine into a data-driven service that supports the modernization of local
                                                                                  
               public transportation.                                             
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Statement of the Problem                                           
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    The study aimed to develop a real-time vehicle tracking and route
                                                                                  
               visualization application for Modern Jeepney commuters and drivers in Bacoor,
                                                                                  
               Cavite, along with a web-based management platform for the Modern Jeepney
                                                                                  
               Operators of PTSMC (Pangkabuhayan Transport Service and Multipurpose
                                                                                  
               Cooperative). The research sought to answer key questions using surveys and
                                                                                  
               resident interviews.                                               
                                                                                  
                    Public transportation in Bacoor, Cavite is numericized by significant
                                                                                  
               inefficiencies that negatively affect both commuters and Modern Jeepney drivers.
                                                                                  
               Commuters experience long and unpredictable waiting times, frequent traffic
                                                                                  
               congestion, and difficulty identifying correct routes and appropriate vehicles. Survey
                                                                                  
               results indicate that 54% of commuters encounter long waiting times, 84% often
                                                                                  
               experience traffic congestion, and more than half report confusion regarding route
                                                                                  
               selection and vehicle availability. The absence of real-time information forces
                                                                                  
               commuters to rely on guesswork, resulting in frustration, wasted time, and unreliable
                                                                                  
               travel experiences. How can real-time vehicle tracking and route visualization be
               integrated into a mobile platform to mitigate commuter uncertainty, reduce waiting
                                                                                  
               times, and enhance navigational confidence?                        
                                                                                  
                    The challenges extend to Modern Jeepney drivers, whose operations are
                                                                                  
               constrained by a mandatory 7–10 minute dispatch protocol (See Appendix 9.
                                                                                  
               Interview Report) that often requires them to depart terminals with far-from-full
                                                                                  
               commuter capacity. Drivers rely on chance (“swertihan”) to pick up additional
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 25 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       4          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               commuters along their routes, leading to inefficient trips, increased fuel consumption,
                                                                                  
               and potential income loss. Furthermore, drivers lack access to real-time data that
                                                                                  
               could help them identify areas of high commuter demand and optimize route
                                                                                  
               performance. How can a system that visualizes real-time commuter demand along a
               fixed route empower drivers to mitigate the inefficiency of low-occupancy trips,
                                                                                  
               thereby converting a luck-based process into a data-driven strategy and ensuring
                                                                                  
               accurate data collection for fleet management?                     
                                                                                  
                    In addition, transport operators face operational limitations due to manual
                                                                                  
               fleet management processes, resulting in limited visibility over driver activity, route
                                                                                  
               performance, and real-time conditions. The transition to modernized jeepney units
                                                                                  
               has also introduced challenges for drivers adapting to digital systems, further
                                                                                  
               affecting coordination and service efficiency.                     
                                                                                  
                    Given the concerns, there is a need for a technology-driven solution that
                                                                                  
               integrates real-time vehicle tracking, route visualization, and operational monitoring.
                                                                                  
               Thus, the study seeks to answer the question: How can a mobile application
                                                                                  
               effectively bridge the gap between commuters seeking reliable transportation and
                                                                                  
               drivers aiming to optimize operations in real time, thereby improving public
                                                                                  
               transportation efficiency in Bacoor, Cavite.                       
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Objectives of the Study                                            
                                                                                  
                    Generally, the study aimed to develop a sustainable and scalable mobile
                                                                                  
               application for commuters and drivers with real-time vehicle tracking and route
               visualization, designed to enhance the efficiency, safety, and accessibility of daily
                                                                                  
               transportation for Modern Jeepney operations in Bacoor, Cavite.    
                                                                                  
                    Specifically, it aimed to:                                    
                                                                                  
                      1. identify the prevailing challenges, pain points, and needs of
                                                                                  
                         commuters, Modern Jeepney drivers, and operators relative to
                                                                                  
                         route visibility, vehicle tracking, and seat availability within Bacoor,
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 26 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       5          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                         Cavite's public transportation system through interviews and survey
                                                                                  
                         questionnaires conducted during Emphatize phase of Design
                                                                                  
                         Thinking methodology;                                    
                                                                                  
                      2. analyze existing transportation, mapping technologies and data
                         management approaches to determine the most efficient and
                                                                                  
                         accurate methods that can provide the integration of GPS-based
                                                                                  
                         real-time tracking, route visualization, and driver-managed seat
                                                                                  
                         availability indicators;                                 
                                                                                  
                      3. develop an application with the use of an Android device for the
                                                                                  
                         system testing and mobile functions, which uses the React Native
                                                                                  
                         v0.82.1 for the mobile and React 18.2.0 for web programming
                                                                                  
                         language in Visual Studio v1.108.2 for the coding process of
                                                                                  
                         creating user applications; Firebase Admin SDK for the database;
                                                                                  
                         Google Maps API for location tracking; Google Docs for the
                                                                                  
                         documentation; and draw.io for the development of diagrams;
                                                                                  
                      4. test the system's core modules by implementing unit testing,
                                                                                  
                         integration testing, data integrity validation, and security testing to
                                                                                  
                         ensure that GPS tracking, status updates, NFC payment    
                                                                                  
                         processing, and management controls operate reliably as intended.
                                                                                  
                      5. evaluate the system’s overall level of user satisfaction in terms of
                                                                                  
                         accessibility, reliability, usability, security, maintainability, and
                                                                                  
                         portability of the system using the ISO 25010.           
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 27 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       6          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Theoretical Framework                                              
                                                                                  
                    The theoretical framework of the SureCut system indicates how technology
                                                                                  
               can help make daily commutes easier and more efficient. It connects commuters to
                                                                                  
               both drivers and operators through key features: registration, real-time tracking, seat
               availability, and digital payment. All system operations are supported by a centralized
                                                                                  
               database that ensures rapid and accurate data access, thereby reducing waiting time
                                                                                  
               and improving route efficiency within Bacoor, Cavite.              
                                                                                  
                    Authentication Module. handles where drivers and vehicles are officially
                                                                                  
               registered in the system by an operator. Once registration is complete, a QR code is
                                                                                  
               created to allow drivers to securely log in and access the platform. This ensures that
                                                                                  
               all users are verified before using the service.                   
                                                                                  
                    Real-time Mapping and Route Visualization Module. helps both  
                                                                                  
               commuters and drivers by displaying live routes and Modern Jeepney locations. It
                                                                                  
               makes it easier for commuters to find available rides and for drivers to locate waiting
                                                                                  
               commuters .                                                        
                                                                                  
                    Commuters Monitoring Module. helps drivers keep track of commuters on
                                                                                  
               board by updating the headcount as commuters are picked up. The system refreshes
                                                                                  
               automatically to prevent duplicate boarding and ensures that the vehicle does not
                                                                                  
               exceed its maximum capacity. It supports safer and more organized boarding
                                                                                  
               throughout the route.                                              
                                                                                  
                    Update Seat Availability Module. uses a simple color-coding system, green
                                                                                  
               for available seats, yellow for nearly full, and red for full capacity. It gives commuters
               a quick overview of which Modern Jeepneys still have room, helping them plan their
                                                                                  
               trips better.                                                      
                                                                                  
                    NFC Payment and Digital Receipt Module. The module serves as a simple
                                                                                  
               and secure way for commuters to pay their fares. Users can top up their NFC card
                                                                                  
               using PayPal, making it easy to add funds anytime. When the commuter taps their
                                                                                  
               card on the NFC reader, the system reads the card’s ID, checks the available
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 28 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       7          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               balance in the database, and automatically deducts the fare. The updated balance is
                                                                                  
               reflected right away, and a digital receipt is sent to the commuter to confirm the
                                                                                  
               transaction. It provides a fast, convenient, and fully cashless payment experience.
                                                                                  
                    All the information from the activities is stored in the database, which keeps
               records updated in real time. It allows the system to retrieve accurate data whenever
                                                                                  
               needed, whether it’s for monitoring operations or generating reports.
                                                                                  
                    Overall, the diagram visualizes how the SureCut system integrates
                                                                                  
               registration, real-time tracking, commuter management, and digital payment into one
                                                                                  
               platform. By using the technologies, the system aims to shorten waiting times,
                                                                                  
               improve route efficiency, and make public transportation more convenient, organized,
                                                                                  
               and reliable for everyone.                                         
                                                                                  
                    The diagram shows how the SureCut works as a system designed to improve
                                                                                  
               the daily commuting experience in Bacoor, Cavite. It highlights the flow of information
                                                                                  
               between the driver, commuter, and operator through different modules connected to
                                                                                  
               a central database.
