                                               
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Figure 1. Theoretical Framework of Surecut: A Mobile Application for Commuters and
                      Drivers with Real-Time Vehicle Tracking and Route Visualization
                                                                                  
                Significance of the Study                                         
                                                                                  
                    The development of Surecut addresses critical problems in public
                                                                                  
               transportation systems by reducing commuter confusion and driver operational
                                                                                  
               inefficiencies.                                                    
                                                                                  
                    For Pangkabuhayan Transport Service Multipurpose Cooperative. The
                                                                                  
               system enhances operational monitoring and coordination by providing real-time
               visibility of vehicles, routes, and driver activities. It supports data-driven decisions
                                                                                  
               and enhances fleet productivity and asset utilization.             
                                                                                  
                    For drivers. It directly mitigates the financial risk associated with the
                                                                                  
               mandatory low-occupancy departures. Also, it transforms commuter pickup from a
                                                                                  
               reactive game of chance into a proactive, data-informed strategy, simplifying
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 30 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       9          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               operational compliance and passenger counting and reducing the energy wasted on
                                                                                  
               unproductive segments of their route.                              
                                                                                  
                    For commuters. The application minimizes delays and stress, encouraging
                                                                                  
               confidence in exploring new areas and daily commutes, whether late or trying out
               new, efficient routes. Furthermore, it introduces the convenience and security of
                                                                                  
               cashless travel.                                                   
                                                                                  
                    For future researchers. It provides an opportunity to tackle complex
                                                                                  
               challenges, innovate the urban mobility sector, and gain valuable knowledge and
                                                                                  
               experience in user applications.                                   
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Time and Place of the Study                                        
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    The research and development of the Surecut application were conducted
                                                                                  
               using the Design Thinking methodology, beginning with data gathering activities prior
                                                                                  
               to the formal study period. The official duration of the study spans from September
                                                                                  
               2025 to April 2026, with all major research activities carried out at the
                                                                                  
               Pangkabuhayan Transport Service and Multipurpose Cooperative (PTSMC) Office
                                                                                  
               located in Pasong Buaya 2, Imus, Cavite. The location served as the primary venue
                                                                                  
               for consultations, design validation, testing, and coordination with operators, drivers,
                                                                                  
               and commuters.                                                     
                                                                                  
                    Initial data gathering commenced in late May 2025 during the Empathize
                                                                                  
               phase of Design Thinking. At this stage, the researchers conducted interviews with
               Modern Jeepney operators and drivers and administered surveys to regular
                                                                                  
               commuters to understand existing transportation challenges and user needs (see
                                                                                  
               Appendix 6. Survey Results and Appendix 9. Interview Reports). The findings from
                                                                                  
               the empathize phase guided the identification of the system’s core requirements and
                                                                                  
               informed the overall design direction of the application.          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 31 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                      10          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    During the Ideate phase, the researchers formulated and refined possible
                                                                                  
               system features and solutions based on the identified transportation concerns.
                                                                                  
               Proposed concepts such as color-coded seat availability, real-time seat capacity
                                                                                  
               updates to improve commuter decision-making and assist drivers in providing timely
               information.                                                       
                                                                                  
                    Following data gathering, the study progressed through the succeeding
                                                                                  
               Design Thinking phases—Define, Prototype, and Iterate—within the research
                                                                                  
               timeline. Wireframes and prototypes were developed and refined through
                                                                                  
               consultations and academic guidance to ensure alignment with both operational
                                                                                  
               practices and study objectives (See Appendix 11 Low Fidelity Wireframe and
                                                                                  
               Appendix 12 High Fidelity Wireframe).                              
                                                                                  
                    From January 2026 to April 2026, the study entered the Test and Iteration
                                                                                  
               phases, during which the developed prototype was evaluated by intended users and
                                                                                  
               cooperative representatives. Feedback collected during the said period supported
                                                                                  
               further refinements to improve usability and functionality. The structured timeline of
                                                                                  
               activities undertaken throughout the study is presented in the Gantt Chart (see
                                                                                  
               Appendix Table 1. Gantt Chart).                                    
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Scope and Limitation of the Study                                  
                                                                                  
                    The study developed “Surecut”, a transportation navigation and management
                                                                                  
               system with real-time vehicle tracking, route visualization, and cashless payment via
               NFC. The system aimed to provide the Pangkabuhayan Transport Service
                                                                                  
               Multipurpose Cooperative (PTSMC) and the commuting public in Bacoor City with an
                                                                                  
               efficient and data-driven fleet management and navigation platform. An Android
                                                                                  
               application was designed for commuters and fixed-wage drivers, while a web-based
                                                                                  
               platform was created for the General Manager to oversee fleet operations and
                                                                                  
               financial reporting.                                               
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 32 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       11         
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    The PTSMC General Manager manages system functionality, including fleet
                                                                                  
               asset supervision, the suspension of drivers with violations, and the generation of
                                                                                  
               consolidated reports for the Cooperative Bookkeeper. Drivers could manually update
                                                                                  
               seat availability (Red/Yellow/Green) and record total passenger counts to validate
               fuel consumption, while commuters could view real-time vehicle locations and
                                                                                  
               process cashless payments through the Android app.                 
                                                                                  
                    The study identified specific operational boundaries. The system focused
                                                                                  
               exclusively on the 27 Modernized Jeepney units acquired through the DBP loan,
                                                                                  
               excluding the 11 traditional consolidated jeepneys. Successful implementation
                                                                                  
               depended on the accurate digital tracking of passenger volume to protect the
                                                                                  
               Cooperative’s financial interests, since drivers are receiving fixed wage regardless of
                                                                                  
               ticket sales.                                                      
                                                                                  
                    The study also highlighted the need for data integrity and security. Commuter
                                                                                  
               access was restricted to read-only geospatial data and personal wallet management
                                                                                  
               to mitigate unauthorized alteration of operational records. It ensured that only the
                                                                                  
               General Manager could modify route statuses or financial logs.     
                                                                                  
                    However, the system had some limitations. It did not support offline mode
                                                                                  
               since it was a real-time application relying on live GPS updates. Minimum
                                                                                  
               requirements for the mobile application included Android 10 or higher (API Level
                                                                                  
               21+), 4 GB RAM, 500 MB of free storage, and an active internet connection.
                                                                                  
               Hardware requirements included a GPS module, NFC (Near-Field Communication)
                                                                                  
               capability for payment processing, and mobile data connectivity. The system’s
               tracking features were limited to the specific Paliparan to SM Southmall route (via
                                                                                  
               Molino Road and Daang Hari), and any vehicle deviation beyond these endpoints
                                                                                  
               would not be visualized. Additionally, the system did not include a direct
                                                                                  
               communication or messaging feature between operators and drivers within the
                                                                                  
               platform. The study also recognized a possible margin of error in fare transaction
                                                                                  
               monitoring, particularly because the system supported both cash and NFC payment
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 33 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                      12          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               methods. Inconsistencies may occur when commuters select cash payment within
                                                                                  
               the application but fail to complete the actual payment, or discrepancies may arise
                                                                                  
               between the transactions recorded in the system and the total fare amount remitted
                                                                                  
               by drivers.                                                        
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Definition of Terms                                                
                                                                                  
                    The definition of terms refers to the clarification and explanation of key
                                                                                  
               concepts, terms, and terminology used in the study. It helps readers understand
                                                                                  
               the specific meanings and context of the terms within the research.
                                                                                  
                    Account-Based System. A payment architecture where a user's monetary
                                                                                  
               value is stored in a centralized backend database, linked to a user's account, rather
                                                                                  
               than on a physical card. The card or device serves only as an identifier to access the
                                                                                  
               account.                                                           
                                                                                  
                    Application Programming Interface (API). A set of protocols and tools used
                                                                                  
               in the development of the application to allow communication between the Surecut
                                                                                  
               mobile app and external services, specifically utilized for integrating Google Maps for
                                                                                  
               route visualization.                                               
                                                                                  
                    Data-Driven Analytics. Utilized in Surecut to improve navigation accuracy,
                                                                                  
               optimize travel times, and provide a seamless connection between commuters and
                                                                                  
               drivers. It's also part of the real-time mapping and route visualization module.
                                                                                  
                    Data Latency. The time delay between the transmission of data from the
                                                                                  
               driver’s device and its reception on the commuter’s device         
                    Design Thinking Method. A non-linear, iterative process that teams use to
                                                                                  
               understand users, challenge assumptions, redefine problems and create innovative
                                                                                  
               solutions to prototype and test.                                   
                                                                                  
                    Digital Divide. A socioeconomic concept referenced in the study describing
                                                                                  
               the gap between drivers who are proficient with modern digital technologies
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 34 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                      13          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               (smartphones, apps) and those who struggle to adapt to the modernized Modern
                                                                                  
               Jeepney systems.                                                   
                                                                                  
                    Geospatial Data. Information that identifies the geographic location of
                                                                                  
               features and boundaries on Earth, utilized by the application to map the specific
                                                                                  
               routes of Modern Jeepneys from Paliparan to SM Southmall.          
                                                                                  
                    GPS Technology. Abbreviation for Global Positioning System. An accurate
                                                                                  
               worldwide navigational and surveying facility based on the reception of signals from
                                                                                  
               an array of orbiting satellites. A core technology integrated into Surecut to assist in
                                                                                  
               navigation, allowing efficient travel, crucial for real-time tracking and route
                                                                                  
               visualization.                                                     
                                                                                  
                    Likert Scale. A psychometric scale used in the statistical treatment of data,
               where respondents specified their level of agreement to statements regarding the
                                                                                  
               system’s usability on a 5-point scale.                             
                                                                                  
                    Near-Field Communication. A short-range wireless technology that allows
                                                                                  
               for secure data exchange between devices when brought into close proximity. In
                                                                                  
               Surecut, it is used to identify a commuter's account for processing fare payments.
                                                                                  
                    Pangkabuhayan Transport Service and Multi-purpose Cooperative. The
                                                                                  
               client of the study and the primary focus of the Surecut implementation.
                                                                                  
                    QR Code. An identification method used by drivers to access vehicle details,
                                                                                  
               which will be kept on the driver's side of the vehicle during trips.
                                                                                  
                    React Native. The open-source user interface software framework created by
                                                                                  
               Meta, used in the development of the Surecut mobile application for Android devices.
                                                                                  
                    Real-Time Mapping. A key feature of Surecut that helps users locate nearby
                                                                                  
               Modern Jeepneys and identify available routes.                     
                                                                                  
                    Route Visualization. A feature of Surecut that helps users identify available
                                                                                  
               routes and estimate travel time.                                   
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 35 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                      14          
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    Slovin’s Formula. The statistical formula used by the researchers to
                                                                                  
               determine the appropriate sample size (140 respondents) needed to represent the
                                                                                  
               target population with a specific margin of error.                 
                                                                                  
                    Urban Mobility Sector. The industry or area of focus concerned with the
               movement of people and goods within cities, which the Surecut application aims to
                                                                                  
               innovate.
