===== PAGE 101 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       80         
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Module Construction and Prototype Refinement                       
                                                                                  
                    Each part of the module required coding to meet the requirements. The
                                                                                  
               system prototype includes all the designs created and identified by constructing all its
                                                                                  
               modules. A listing module was identified, and alternatives and position interaction
                                                                                  
               through requirements were discussed. The modules were designed, built, and tested
                                                                                  
               to determine the system's performance.                             
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Software Testing                                                   
                                                                                  
                    The system's features and functionality were thoroughly tested using Test
                                                                                  
               Cases (see Appendix Table 3), Unit Testing (see Appendix Table 4), and Integration
                                                                                  
               Testing (see Appendix Table 5).                                    
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               System Evaluation                                                  
                                                                                  
                    The system's features and functionalities were thoroughly tested based on the
                                                                                  
               requirements defined during the development of the SURECUT system. Software
                                                                                  
               evaluation was done by the expected respondents of the system, such as
                                                                                  
               Commuters, PTSMC Members, and IT Professionals. The total number of the
                                                                                  
               respondents was 100 Commuters, 30 PTSMC Members, and 10 IT Professionals
                                                                                  
               evaluated the software using ISO 25010 with a set of Criteria such as Functional
                                                                                  
               Suitability, Performance Efficiency, Compatibility, Usability, Reliability, Security,
                                                                                  
               Maintainability, and Portability.                                  
                                                                                  
                    The technical aspects of the software were rated using a Five-Point Likert
                                                                                  
               Scale, where 5 – Excellent, 4 – Very Satisfactory, 3 – Satisfactory, 2 – Fair, and 1 –
                                                                                  
               Poor. The evaluation results were analyzed and interpreted using weighted means to
                                                                                  
               determine the level of performance and user satisfaction of the system.
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 102 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       81         
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    Table 6 shows the respondents' evaluation of the SURECUT system as
                                                                                  
               Excellent in terms of Functional Completeness, with a weighted mean of 4.89, which
                                                                                  
               was verbally interpreted as Excellent. Functional Correctness, with a weighted mean
                                                                                  
               of 4.91, was also rated as Excellent, while Functional Appropriateness, with a
               weighted mean of 4.89, was likewise interpreted as Excellent. Overall, the
                                                                                  
               respondents rated the SURECUT system as Excellent in terms of Functional
                                                                                  
               Suitability, with a general weighted mean of 4.90.                 
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Table 6. Functional suitability assessment of the software         
                                             WEIGHTED       VERBAL                
                    FUNCTIONAL SUITABILITY                                        
                                               MEAN     INTERPRETATION            
                  1. Functional completeness - the                                
                    degree to which the set of                                    
                                               4.89         Excellent             
                    functions covers all the specified                            
                    tasks and user objectives.                                    
                  2. Functional correctness – the                                 
                    degree to which the system                                    
                                               4.91         Excellent             
                    provides correct results with the                             
                    required level of accuracy.                                   
                  3. Functional appropriateness – the                             
                    degree to which the system                                    
                                               4.89         Excellent             
                    functions help users accomplish                               
                    tasks efficiently.                                            
                   GENERAL WEIGHTED MEAN       4.90       EXCELLENT               
                    As shown in the table 7, the respondents rated the “SURECUT: A Mobile
                                                                                  
               Application for Commuters and Drivers with Real-Time Vehicle Tracking and Route
                                                                                  
               Visualization” as Excellent in terms of Time Behavior, with a weighted mean of 4.50,
                                                                                  
               which was verbally interpreted as Excellent. Resource Utilization, with a weighted
                                                                                  
               mean of 4.81, was rated as Excellent, and Capacity, with a weighted mean of 4.89,
                                                                                  
               was also rated as Excellent. Overall, the respondents rated the application as
                                                                                  
               Excellent in terms of Performance Efficiency, with an overall mean of 4.71.

                         SUMMARY, CONCLUSION, AND RECOMMENDATION                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    The chapter presents a summary of the research and its findings, the
                                                                                  
               conclusions derived from the study, and the recommendations for the system’s future
                                                                                  
               development. Each section is structured to demonstrate how the researchers
                                                                                  
               addressed the specific objectives established at the beginning of the study by
                                                                                  
               integrating the empirical data gatherers during the evaluation phase.
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Summary                                                            
                                                                                  
                    The Surecut: Vehicle Tracking and Management System was developed to
                                                                                  
               modernize public transportation operations, enhance fleet monitoring, and facilitate
                                                                                  
               cashless transactions for the Pangkabuhayan Transport Service and Multi-Purpose
                                                                                  
               Cooperative (PTSMC). In direct fulfillment of the study’s first two objectives, the
                                                                                  
               research began by identifying the prevailing challenges of route visibility and seat
                                                                                  
               availability through the Emphatize phase of the Agile Design Thinking methodology.
                                                                                  
               The user-centric approach allowed for the analysis of existing mapping technologies
                                                                                  
               to determine the most accurate methods for real-time tracking. To meet the technical
                                                                                  
               objectives, the system was built using React Native for the mobile application and
                                                                                  
               React.js for the web-based Operator Dashboard, integrating the Google Maps API
                                                                                  
               and Firebase Admin SDK to handle location data and seat availability indicators. The
                                                                                  
               final phases of the study focused on testing and evaluation, where the system’s core
                                                                                  
               modules were validated for reliability and security. Software evaluation using the ISO
                                                                                  
               25010 standard yielded a total rating of 4.83, interpreted as “Excellent,” confirming
                                                                                  
               that the system satisfied the needs of commuters, PTSMC members, and IT
                                                                                  
               professionals alike.                                               
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 113 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       92         
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Conclusion                                                         
                                                                                  
                    The development of the Surecut mobile application addresses the critical
                                                                                  
               fragmentation within the public transportation system of Bacoor, Cavite by aligning
                                                                                  
               technical innovation with the lived experiences of its stakeholders. By identifying the
                                                                                  
               prevailing challenges and pain points of commuters and drivers during the Empathize
                                                                                  
               Phase of the Design Thinking methodology, the study moved beyond general
               assumptions to target specific needs in route visibility and vehicle tracking. The high
                                                                                  
               functional completeness score of 4.89 provides empirical evidence that the
                                                                                  
               frustrations captured through interviews and surveys were effectively translated into a
                                                                                  
               system that accurately addresses the community’s practical requirements.
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    A critical component of the study’s success was the deep analysis of existing
                                                                                  
               transportation and mapping technologies to determine the most accurate methods for
                                                                                  
               real-time integration. By evaluating various data management approaches, the
                                                                                  
               researchers were able to synthesize a framework that seamlessly combines
                                                                                  
               GPS-based tracking with driver-managed seat availability indicators. The analytical
                                                                                  
               foundation ensured that the system did not just track vehicles, but provided a reliable
                                                                                  
               data stream that mirrors the actual, fluid conditions of the Bacoor public transport
               environment.                                                       
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    The technical realization of these goals was achieved through a robust
                                                                                  
               development stack, utilizing React Native for cross-platform mobile functionality and
                                                                                  
               Firebase for real-time database management. Developing the application using these
                                                                                  
               professional-grade tools allowed for a high-quality interface that prioritizes user
                                                                                  
               experience, as evidenced by the "Excellent" ratings in usability and aesthetics. The
                                                                                  
               phase of the study demonstrated that sophisticated software architecture can be
                                                                                  
               successfully adapted to localized transport needs, providing a scalable solution that
                                                                                  
               can be managed through standard Android devices.                   
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 114 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       93         
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    To ensure long-term visibility and trust, the study prioritized the integrity of the
                                                                                  
               system’s core operations through rigorous multi-level testing. By implementing unit
                                                                                  
               and integration testing alongside security protocols, the researchers validated that
                                                                                  
               GPS accuracy, NFC payment processing, and management controls operate
               reliability under various conditions. The high marks in security and accountability
                                                                                  
               further confirm that the backend architecture is capable of maintaining data integrity,
                                                                                  
               ensuring that all system actions are uniquely traceable and secure for both the
                                                                                  
               transport cooperative and the commuting public                     
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                    Finally, the comprehension evaluation against the ISO 25010 standard serves
                                                                                  
               as a technical validation of the study’s overall success. While the exceptional ratings
                                                                                  
               in portability and maintainability indicate that the software is ready to evolve
                                                                                  
               alongside hardware changes in Bacoor, the performance efficiency results provide a
                                                                                  
               vital roadmap for future iterations. Specifically, the findings regarding time behavior
                                                                                  
               suggest that as the system scales to accommodate more residents, continuous
                                                                                  
               optimization will be required to maintain the responsiveness expected of a real-time
               tool. Ultimately, Surecut marks a significant step forward to a more efficient, safe, and
                                                                                  
               transparent transportation network for the Bacoor community.       
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
               Recommendations                                                    
                                                                                  
                    The following are recommended as measures to enhance the system’s
                                                                                  
               performance:                                                       
                                                                                  
                 1. The system can be upgraded by integrating a language toggle between
                                                                                  
                    different languages throughout the app UI to make the platform more
                                                                                  
                    accessible to a wider demographic of users in Bacoor and surrounding areas.
                                                                                  
                 2. The application should be expanded to include a dedicated iOS version to
                                                                                  
                    ensure platform inclusivity.                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  

===== PAGE 115 =====
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                       94         
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                 3. The system should explore the integration of Artificial Intelligence powered
                                                                                  
                    chatbot to improve user support and engagement when the user has
                                                                                  
                    experienced theft or to retrieve lost items.                  
                                                                                  
                 4. The system may include accessibility options such as voice assistance, larger
                    text interfaces, and high-contrast modes to accommodate users with
                                                                                  
                    disabilities.
